title: Can I Survive MORE Drawback Chess?
summary: More Drawback Chess vs anonymous humans: goal win five games. His drawbacks include Noblesse Oblige (royal pieces only capture royal pieces), Checkers (must capture if able - 'basically playing giveaway chess except I don't want to lose') and Gloomstalker (only capture from dark squares). Opponent drawbacks revealed: Reconnaissance, Shell Shocked, Checkers (same as his), Comfort Zone (if you can move to f5 you must), among others. He loses one game and gets the fifth win in game 6.
rules: Standard start, random secret drawback per player, revealed after the game.
King capture wins; no checkmate requirement; winning on time also counts.

Drawbacks seen: Noblesse Oblige - your royal pieces (kings and queens) can only capture other royal pieces; Checkers - you must capture if able; Gloomstalker - you can only capture from dark squares; Reconnaissance - you start unable to capture (until a condition; text cut off); Shell Shocked - pieces adjacent to an enemy capture can't move for one turn; Comfort Zone - if you can move to f5 you must.
win_condition: Capture the enemy king / opponent drawback loss / flag. Series goal: 5 wins (took 6 games).

opponent.name: Anonymous animal handles (e.g. 'probing green alien', Remann)
